name: zacharticulatev
description: Claude Code plugins by Zachary W. — web design, SEO, and project memory and engineering tooling. Each plugin lives in its own repository and installs independently.

plugins.name: designer-pro-and-seo
plugins.description: Web design + SEO + build-workflow skills: design-system generation and on-brand page rendering, design tokens, build briefs, pre-delivery QA, portable-HTML porting for any CMS, and a full SEO suite covering technical, schema, sitemap, content, GEO, hreflang, drift, local, and e-commerce.

plugins.name: compound-memory
plugins.description: Memory, planning, building, review, verification, shipping, and learning for coding agents. Twelve skills that each work alone and hand work to one another through files in the repository: project-memory (keeps a project's memory accurate and evidence-backed across sessions, branches, and worktrees), plan, prototype, build, debug, review, verify, ship, autopilot, learn, write, and catch-up. Deterministic Node scripts check what must be exact, and an independent auditor runs on an external model.
